description: This file defines a custom exception class 'LeaveAllocationServiceException' within the 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Exception' namespace. It provides static methods to instantiate exceptions with specific message strings related to leave management errors in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeaveAllocationServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling leave allocation related errors within the OrangeHRM leave module.

methods.name: overlappingLeavesFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating overlapping leave requests were found.

methods.name: workShiftLengthExceeded
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the work shift length has been exceeded.

methods.name: leaveBalanceExceeded
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the leave balance has been exceeded.

methods.name: leaveQuotaWillExceed
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the leave quota will be exceeded.

methods.name: noWorkingDaysSelected
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating no working days were selected.

methods.name: cannotApplyLeaveBeyondMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating leave application beyond the maximum allowed end date.

methods.name: cannotAssignLeaveBeyondMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating leave assignment beyond the maximum allowed end date.
